architecture:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: lead architecture graphic for the GitHub README of "Agent Toolchain", open-source developer tooling for local Claude Code and Codex work.
Create a polished editorial technology diagram, landscape canvas approximately 1800 x 1000. Warm off-white paper background, dark charcoal typography, crisp architectural rules, generous whitespace, restrained amber and teal accents. Premium technical field-guide aesthetic, clear flat schematic illustration with a little layered-paper depth. No glow, no robot mascots, no gradients, no tiny illegible text, no invented metrics.
Header at upper left: "AGENT TOOLCHAIN". Secondary headline: "One project. Two workflows." Small upper-right label: "SYSTEM MAP".
Main diagram flows left to right with only the following labelled blocks, grouped into clear regions:
Left region heading "PROJECT KNOWLEDGE"; block "Repository route"; small supporting labels "AGENTS.md" and "Docs + lessons".
Center region heading "SHARED WORKFLOWS"; two separate vertically stacked cards. First card "Execution" with subtitle "Approved work + evidence". Second card "Management" with subtitle "Assess + maintain + adopt". A short supporting bar beneath both cards labelled "Focused helper tools".
Right region heading "YOUR HARNESS"; two equal parallel alternatives "Claude Code" and "Codex", with a clearly visible "OR" between them. Both lead to a final bottom-right output card "Code + docs + evidence".
Connect Repository route to both workflow cards with neat directional arrows. Connect both workflow cards toward the two harness alternatives, then toward the output. Never draw an arrow from Claude Code to Codex: they are alternative harnesses. Draw one thin unobtrusive return line from output back to repository knowledge, labelled "Lessons return to the repository".
Footer across bottom in modest but legible text: "Local execution. Explicit adoption. Durable history."
Require exact spelling, readable text at 900 px display width, no additional labels, logos, account names, personal paths, URLs, or private project references. Keep connectors non-crossing and layout easy to scan. This image is a real explanatory architecture diagram, not decorative cover art.
execution_flow:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: GitHub README explanatory data-flow graphic for Agent Toolchain. A companion to a warm ivory editorial architecture diagram with charcoal type, thin rules, teal workflow outlines and amber document accents.
Create a carefully typeset landscape diagram about 2000 x 1000, generous whitespace, warm off-white paper, bold condensed sans-serif headings, elegant readable serif card labels, small clean outline document/tool icons. Flat technical publication design, no 3D, no glow, no decorative gradients. All labels large enough at 1000px display width.
Title "From intent to evidence". Small eyebrow "EXECUTION FLOW".
Arrange SEVEN compact numbered stages left to right in one clear main horizontal row, with arrows only forward between neighboring stages:
"01" / "Approved outcome"
"02" / "Repository route"
"03" / "Scoped task"
"04" / "Build"
"05" / "Independent review"
"06" / "Local checks"
"07" / "Milestone PR + merge"
Two-line labels are fine. The last three need ample width. The timeline should occupy the middle width and be the dominant content.
Above the timeline, a slim restrained annotation: "Human approvals: design · plan · merge".
Below the main row show TWO clearly labelled feedback paths with arrowheads at their destinations:
A short teal return arrow FROM Independent review back TO Build labelled "Findings return for correction".
A long amber return arrow FROM Milestone PR + merge back TO Repository route labelled "Lessons update project knowledge".
Under Local checks, one small subordinate annotation: "Tests + area gate + local E2E". It represents the progression toward milestone readiness, not every task's test requirement.
At the bottom separated by a thin rule, three evenly spaced succinct notes with simple icons:
"Scoped writes" ; "Independent judgement" ; "Local evidence".
Small footer sentence: "Deployment is a separate, explicitly authorized step."
Exact spelling; no invented metrics, extra paragraphs, vendor logos, accounts, private identifiers, or URLs. Do not add a deployment node to the timeline. Do not show reviewer as the writer of the correction. Preserve the exact arrow directions and show the two feedback paths on separate vertical levels without collisions.
